curated.tagline: OpenRouter eval harness for cheap orchestrator + worker stacks
curated.description: Eval harness that tests whether a cheap orchestrator plus cheap workers can produce frontier-quality output through OpenRouter routing.

release.transcript: A launch film for orchestral, the OpenRouter eval harness for cheap orchestrator and worker stacks.

demo.transcript: A 20-second terminal recording: orchestral's leaderboard ranks orchestrator and worker pairings by pass rate and cost per pass, then the pairings report shows quality per dollar. Model names are anonymized.

curated.architecture: Prompt bench → orchestrator → worker pool → scoring → report
